question: As of March 2021, which Indian state stands first in Jute production?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• West Bengal stands at the first position with over 50% of total raw jute production in the country.
 
• The jute crop is grown in seven states - West Bengal, Assam, Orissa, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Tripura and Meghalaya.
 
• In Bihar-Katihar, Samastipur, Champaran, Darbhanga, Saharsa and Purnia are major jute producing areas.
 
• Purnia is the largest jute producing district of Bihar. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Recently the Government has mandated the packaging of 100% of foodgrain and 20% of sugar in jute bags.
 
• Jute crop requires a humid climate with temperature fluctuating between 24 degree Celsius and 38 degree Celsius.
 
• Jute production is referred to as Golden fibre revolution in India.
 
• National Jute Board, Ministry of Textiles, acts as the apex body for the promotion of the products in India and abroad.
